Anduril Industries is a defense technology company developing advanced systems for U.S. and allied military capabilities. The Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer will own CI/CD and integration test infrastructure for command and control software, while supporting observability systems, data pipelines, and migration to next-generation infrastructure tooling.

Build and maintain Grafana dashboards and Prometheus metrics for system and test observability
Support integration with the team's Data Lake for test and system performance data
